name: cannae
title: The Battle of Cannae
summary: Hannibal lets his centre give ground until the Roman army has walked into a bag, then closes his Libyans and his cavalry round it and annihilates the largest army Rome ever put in the field.

name: alesia
title: The Siege of Alesia
summary: Caesar shuts Vercingetorix inside two rings of ditch and rampart, twenty-one miles of them, and holds both faces at once when a Gallic army four times his size comes down on his back.

name: nile
title: The Battle of the Nile
summary: Nelson finds the French fleet moored across Aboukir Bay, doubles its van at sunset and fights all night; by the second morning only two ships of the line are left to escape.

name: copenhagen
title: The Battle of Copenhagen
summary: Nelson takes twelve of the line up the King's Deep, destroys the Danish line of blockships at anchor, and ends the day under a flag of truce.

name: trafalgar
title: The Battle of Trafalgar
summary: Nelson's two columns cut Villeneuve's line off Cape Trafalgar and destroy the Combined Fleet in an afternoon.

name: little-bighorn
title: The Battle of the Little Bighorn
summary: Custer divides the 7th Cavalry and attacks the largest village on the plains from two directions; within an hour his own five companies are surrounded on a ridge above the ford and killed to the last man.

name: midway
title: The Battle of Midway
summary: Four Japanese carriers steam on an atoll two hundred miles away, are caught with their decks full, and burn within six minutes of each other; the fourth is found and burned that afternoon.
